notes: Round 10 runs several tracks at once, each in its own worktree: M1 (land animals), M2 (water mobs), M3 (night mobs) and W's w3 (the game events W's first merge left out). D0's d0b (silverfish in stone, endermites from pearls, flying navigation) is merged (c0366f3a), and release 6 is built with PROTOCOL 11 (789f6d23). Never bump minecraft_net::PROTOCOL: the release step bumps it once when messages changed; if a commit changes a ToClient/ToServer message or the codec, add a line under '## Protocol' in the track log. Insert new match arms and list entries next to related ones, not at the end of lists, to keep merges small (E3-0 names the few positional lists that are appended). Record decisions in the track log. LOAD: builds run at -j 4 per slot to keep the laptop cool; never start a second cargo command, the game, or any other long CPU-heavy process. Keep to the brief: each section names the commit its file:line anchors come from, so re-check every anchor before editing; keep off the hooks the M briefs own and follow the cross-area overlaps (both in E3-0). E2's e2b (44d96765) and D0's d0b (c0366f3a) are merged, so every 'waits for e2b', 'after d0b' and 'release 6 built' in the brief is met; d0b moved lines in server.rs, world.rs, walk_path.rs, entity_view.rs and families.rs, so anchors taken before it need a re-check. The orchestrator brings track-e3 up to minecraft-survival before each segment, so the review uses git diff r10-e3j-base..HEAD as usual. SEGMENT e3j: the rest of E3-8 (named containers and banners keep their data, door cracks stay after their mob dies), then E3-9's hits on registered mobs. E3-9's rocket-end-targets and elytra-rockets moved to e3k, which waits for W's w3: w3's events-items edits tick_rockets and the rocket hits they change.

groups.prompt: Track E3 group placed-names: build track-e3.md section E3-8 group placed-names. Commits: (1) 'Named Minecraft chests, barrels, furnaces and brewing stands keep their names when placed and broken', (2) 'Named Minecraft hoppers, dispensers, droppers, enchanting tables and beacons keep their names', (3) 'A Minecraft banner broken right after it is placed keeps its patterns'. Key points for commit 1: crates/minecraft_terrain/src/containers.rs gets name_placed(pos, stack) beside place_shulker (:913). It sets or clears names from minecraft:custom_name, makes the store entry its kind needs so block_entity_tag (:797) exports CustomName, and marks it dirty. Also add name_value(pos). In crates/minecraft_survival/src/actions.rs, after the shulker branch (:1590-1598), call it for Station::of Chest, Barrel, Oven or Brewer (not Shulker or Ender). harvest's kept (:1763) chains {minecraft:custom_name} for those before drop_blocks (:1797) and spill (:1800). menus.rs:331 uses the first cell's name, else the second's (ChestBlock$2$1.getDisplayName). Commit 2: world/src/level/components.rs implicit gives (CUSTOM_NAME, "CustomName") for hopper, dispenser, dropper, crafter, enchanting_table and beacon; dropped_components gives [custom_name] for those minus the crafter (26.3 loot tables). The is_banner pair at actions.rs:1599-1608 becomes a components::takes_components(id) helper. Commit 3: Entities (crates/minecraft_survival/src/entities.rs:63) gets placed_components: HashMap<BlockPos, Value>, set in block_entity_components (:1096). Any placement at a pos drops its old entry first. harvest (:1774-1779) falls back to the entry when dropped_components(stored) gives none, filtered by the kind's loot list (components::dropped_from_item), and removes the entry either way. Lock, container contents and block_entity_data are left out (decision). Tests as the brief lists. Owner's steps N-1..N-5 and N-MP plus the kit go in docs/round10/track-e3-log.md. No wire change.

Track E3 group door-cracks: build track-e3.md section E3-8 group door-cracks. Commit: 'A Minecraft door crack stays up to 20 seconds after its mob dies like vanilla'. Key points: third_party/minecraftoss/entities/src/door_goals.rs gets KeptCrack { mob, pos, stage, since } and EntityWorld::keep_door_cracks(&mut self), using self.game_time: each live crack updates or adds its entry (since restarts on a pos or stage change); an entry whose mob is alive without a crack goes (BreakDoorGoal.stop sends -1); an entry whose mob is dead or gone stays until a tick with game_time % 20 == 0 finds it more than 400 ticks old (ClientLevel.removeBlockBreakingProgress). door_cracks() (:309-321) returns the kept entries. Vendored world.rs gets a kept_cracks field next to level_events (:2598), its default (:2739) and a clone_where line (:5826), so the host's view and friends get it. crates/minecraft_terrain/src/server.rs:1455 calls self.mobs.keep_door_cracks() after the level event drain. session.rs and render_anim are unchanged. Tests: door_goals tests for expiry, stop and removal, and a session test next to a_friend_sees_a_zombies_door_crack_grow_and_clear (:3109). Log that this replaces E2's decision 3. Owner's steps K-1, K-2 and K-MP plus the kit go in docs/round10/track-e3-log.md. No wire change.

Track E3 group registered-hits: build track-e3.md section E3-9 group registered-hits. Commits: (1) 'Registered Minecraft mobs learn which thrown thing or firework hurt them'; (2) 'Breezes let llama spit fly through them unhurt'.

Key points (anchors at d565a3d2; re-check after d0b's merge):
- Commit 1, two changed lines:
  - third_party/minecraftoss/entities/src/world/combat.rs:494, the family arm of hurt_for_player, passes `kind` instead of "minecraft:player_attack".
  - entities/src/world.rs:3078, the family arm of hurt_by_typed_blast, passes `kind` instead of blaster.damage_type().
  - Keep the attacker in .by(Some(Target::Player(player)), ..). Vanilla's breeze targets whoever is in its HURT_BY memory (HurtBySensor sets it from getLastDamageSource; BreezeAi.initIdleActivity has a StartAttacking on it), so a player's wind charge does turn a breeze on the player.
  - Do not add a no-anger skip for families. Log that E2's merge note in decisions.md was wrong.
- Commit 2:
  - LlamaSpit (entities/src/llama_spit.rs:28) gains deflected_by: Option<u64>. It is None in spit() and in the literals at crates/minecraft_terrain/src/server_mobs.rs:1189 and crates/minecraft_survival/src/entity_view.rs:1843.
  - world.rs gets `pub(super) fn spit_deflected(&mut self, spit, target) -> bool` next to mob_shot_mob (:3977). It asks families.deflect(target, "minecraft:llama_spit") once per deflector; that call queues the breeze's deflect voice.
  - equines.rs:724 changes `} else {` to `} else if !self.spit_deflected(id, target) {`. This is the only line in M3's equines.rs.
  - The spit keeps its course: vanilla LlamaSpit.tick re-sets its motion from the movement it took before hitTargetOrDeflectSelf.
- M2's m2e puts its family knockback hook in front of these family arms (E3-0): keep both sides at a merge. Later groups (mob-shots-blame, ominous-shots) rely on the world.rs:3078 line and do not edit it again.
- Tests: a rabbit or polar bear records thrown, trident, fireworks and player_attack; a breeze keeps the player as attacker after a wind charge; spit hurts a silverfish and flies on through a breeze, which is unhurt and whooshes once.
- Give the owner's steps RH-1 to RH-3 and the section's kit line.
